title: Automated Legal Document Summarization for Boutique Law Firms
business: Boutique law firms handling high volumes of discovery documents.
problem: Attorneys struggle with the cognitive load of manually reviewing hundreds of pages of case discovery to extract key arguments, leading to potential oversight of critical details.
solution: Utilizing the GPT-4 model via the Chat Completions API, firms can automate the extraction of core legal arguments and entity relationships from text-based discovery documents, providing a structured summary for human review.
steps: Ingest raw text discovery documents into a secure processing pipeline.
Format the text into structured prompts for the gpt-4-0613 snapshot to ensure consistent output behavior.
Send requests to the v1/chat/completions endpoint with specific instructions to identify parties and claims.
Parse the returned text output to populate a case management database for attorney review.
outcome: Improved efficiency in document triage, allowing attorneys to focus on high-level legal strategy rather than initial data extraction.
limitation: The 8,192 token context window limit restricts the size of individual documents that can be processed in a single request; check for truncation by monitoring the finish_reason in the API response.
